n_decision: OPEN, and not this file's to close: n is carried over from round 2 unchanged, and the three candidate sizes are costed in reading.md against the per-arm cost round 2 MEASURED. Four of the five arms have such a figure; mnema++ does not exist and has none, so its column is a stand-in and is labelled one. The size of the round is a spending decision and it belongs to whoever holds the budget.
development_criterion: the pilot is the lowest-numbered axis-A task; the second development task is the lowest-numbered axis-A task whose discriminant runs on a runtime the pilot's does not. Blind to what any task contains, and stated here rather than inherited: round 2's report describes this criterion as reproducing round 1's pick, and it does not — round 1's a1 and a2 already cover two runtimes and a3 was the one chosen.
rule: held-out tasks are touched once; any iteration after seeing a held-out result contaminates them
